cases.prompt: Add a Trusted by section with the logos of Stripe, Vercel, Supabase, and GitHub. Grayscale, and it must work in dark mode.
must: resolve each brand on Logoforge before writing JSX
use the real component or SVG file for each brand
use mono or original colors, never an arbitrary recolor
give each logo a consistent height and automatic width
work in light and dark mode
avoid duplicate screen-reader names
must_not: invent a slug, component name, or variant
use a screenshot, PNG, or image from the web

cases.prompt: Replace this hand-drawn Notion logo with the real one.
must: delete the hand-made SVG
resolve the notion slug on Logoforge
install or fetch the real component and preserve its ratio
keep the section's accessible name
must_not: fetch a Notion logo from Google Images or a random icon pack

cases.prompt: Add a Sign in with Google button next to the GitHub one.
must: use the real Google mark from Logoforge
keep the visible label as the accessible name
make the logo decorative next to the label
match the existing button height and focus styles
must_not: show a provider the product does not support

cases.prompt: The GitHub logo disappears in dark mode. Fix it.
must: check whether an icon-dark or wordmark-dark variant exists
use mode="auto" when it exists, otherwise mono with the theme text color
verify the result in both themes
must_not: use CSS invert, brightness, or an arbitrary fill

cases.prompt: Make a comparison table with the logos of our competitors.
must: ask for or confirm the real competitor list
keep each logo next to the brand name in the column header
keep the table scrollable on small screens
keep the logos decorative because the header names the brand
must_not: use a logo without a visible or accessible name

cases.prompt: Add the logo of Acme Cloud, a brand I use.
must: search Logoforge and its aliases first
give the prefilled logo-request link when it is absent
use the brand name as text until the logo exists

cases.prompt: Use this SVG I found on a random website for our customer wall.
must: explain that the file has no verified source
offer the Logoforge component or SVG instead
ask for the real customer list before showing the wall
must_not: paste the unverified SVG into the interface
claim the brand is a customer without confirmation

cases.prompt: Our logo strip breaks on mobile. Make it fit without squashing the marks.
must: use a responsive grid or wrap
use h-* w-auto or size-* instead of fixed width and height
keep clear space between marks
must_not: remove accessible names to save space
